# fzv v0.1.0

`fzv` 是 Windows 上的 Zig 版本管理器，名字是 `fuck zig version` 的缩写。

`PATH` 里只有一条 fzv 条目 `<版本目录>\.fzv\bin`，切版本改的是它下面的一个小文件，
所以开着的终端、IDE 和构建工具在下一次调 `zig` 时已经是新版本。

## 安装

```powershell
irm https://github.com/ref42/fzv/releases/latest/download/install.ps1 | iex
```

也可以 `cargo install --git https://github.com/ref42/fzv`，或者下载
`fzv-v0.1.0-windows-x86_64.zip` 解压后把 fzv 加到 `PATH` 里。

## 功能

- 命令：`get` / `use` / `ls` / `lls` / `rm` / `path` / `update` / `v` / `h`。
- 从 ziglang.org 的索引安装：`dev` / `stable` / 精确版本都可以，装完按索引里的
  SHA-256 校验再解压；多个版本可以用空格或逗号隔开（`fzv get dev,stable`）。
- 镜像加速：并发探测 16 个社区镜像，按实测吞吐排序；大文件切成小块由多条连接
  抢着下，`-j N` 指定连接数（1–32，默认 8），中断可以续传。中途开始返回 429 的
  镜像立刻丢掉，剩下的块从下一个镜像继续。
- 装完立刻可用：`zig.exe` / `zls.exe` 和 `fzv.exe` 放在同一个目录（该目录本来就
  在 `PATH` 里），当前终端不用重开。
- 默认只打印必要信息，`-verbose` 才显示镜像选择、校验值、解压路径这些细节。
- `fzv update` 从 GitHub Release 升级 fzv 自己（下载、校验、原地替换）；
  `-force` 是不管版本号相同与否都重装最新 release，用来修装坏的 fzv。
- ZLS 和 Zig 一起进 `PATH`，ZLS 只有共享的一份。

## 说明

- 只支持 Windows（`x86_64` / `aarch64`）。
- 构建需要 nightly 工具链：仓库里 `.cargo/config.toml` 用了一个 `-Z` 参数。
- ZLS 官方不发布校验和，所以 ZLS 的下载不校验。

## 贡献者

- @ref42

## English

`fzv` is a Zig version manager for Windows, short for `fuck zig version`.

`PATH` holds a single fzv entry, `<versions>\.fzv\bin`, and switching a version
rewrites one small file under it, so terminals, editors and build tools that are
already running pick the new version up on their next `zig` invocation.

### Install

```powershell
irm https://github.com/ref42/fzv/releases/latest/download/install.ps1 | iex
```

`cargo install --git https://github.com/ref42/fzv` works too, and so does
unpacking `fzv-v0.1.0-windows-x86_64.zip` and adding fzv to `PATH` by hand.

### Added

- Commands: `get` / `use` / `ls` / `lls` / `rm` / `path` / `update` / `v` / `h`.
- Installs from the official ziglang.org index: `dev`, `stable` or an exact
  version, verified against the published SHA-256 before unpacking; several
  selectors can be given at once (`fzv get dev,stable`).
- Mirrors: 16 community mirrors are probed for real throughput; large archives
  are split into chunks that several connections compete for, `-j N` sets how
  many (1-32, 8 by default), and an interrupted download resumes. A mirror that
  starts answering 429 is dropped and the rest of the chunks come from the next
  one.
- Usable immediately: `zig.exe` / `zls.exe` are written next to `fzv.exe`, in a
  directory `PATH` already reaches, so the terminal you are in needs no restart.
- Quiet by default; `-verbose` brings back the mirror choice, the checksums and
  the unpacking paths.
- `fzv update` upgrades fzv itself from its GitHub releases; `-force` installs
  the newest release even when it is the one already running.
- Zig and ZLS both go on `PATH`, with a single shared ZLS.

### Notes

- Windows only (`x86_64` and `aarch64`).
- Nightly toolchain required: `.cargo/config.toml` passes a `-Z` flag.
- ZLS publishes no checksum, so its download is not verified.
